title: Birch
body:
Description

The Birch Tree is slightly less common than the Oak tree (?) but is still very easy to find around the island of Finlay. It can be identified by its distinctive white and black spotted bark and light green leaves. It was once one of the most profitable tree to farm before the Island Expansion Update, only overshadowed by Palm.

Once cut down, you can sell the log for $1 per stud. If you use the saw or a sander, you will create the sanded version of the wood which sells for $18 per stud. You can also use a planker to get the Planked version, which sells for $22.5 per stud.

There is a variant called Red Birch which is appeared on Finlay Island, surrounded nearby with Maple tree. It's leaves are red and the wood inside also red. This wood is good for anyone curious if there is red Oak planks

Like any other material in the game, you can use logs, sanded, and planked Birch to complete schematics.

Trivia

  • The Birch tree was released in public alpha along with five other trees.
